scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @agent-control-plane/api" "npm run dev -w @agent-control-plane/worker" "npm run dev -w @agent-control-plane/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/api && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/worker && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/domain && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/ui && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/config
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db ACP_DATA_DIR=.test-data FORCE_RESET=1 node scripts/bootstrap-sqlite.mjs && vitest run apps/api/test/p1.integration.test.ts
scripts.db:reset: cross-env FORCE_RESET=1 node scripts/bootstrap-sqlite.mjs && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
